scope: 2020-2021 validation only; saved predictions; no training or new predictions
normal_dividends: CRSP total-return units; distributions reinvested in same security without additional fees; fractional units; not a payment-date share ledger
known_delisting: Apply verified NA terminal total return once; move value to frozen non-tradable receivable. Main scenario holds receivable at that mark until evaluation end. Sensitivities release to cash 5 or 20 market days later. No true settlement date is inferred.
missing_return: Only MP followed by a causally verified P1-P9 whole-span return can resolve pending valuation. Carry last observed asset value as explicitly flagged stale estimate while unavailable; never overwrite source return with zero. Other unresolved held returns stop simulation.
allocation: Pretrade NAV / selected count; sell excess executable positions first; scale ALL buy requests pro rata to available cash including costs before masking failed buys; failed-buy budgets stay cash; failed sells and frozen claims remain assets.
terminal: Skip signals crossing 2021; liquidate executable holdings at final complete horizon 2021-12-30, charge exit costs; unresolved receivables remain in final marked NAV.
primary_metric: Strategy CAGR minus same-cost same-settlement eligible-pool equal-weight CAGR
limitations: Research simulations conditional on declared valuation and settlement assumptions; not verified executable returns or capacity estimates
